headline: NCP removes Joint General Secretary Salauddin Tanvir from post
summary: The National Citizen's Platform (NCP) has temporarily suspended the party official from his position.
details: The National Citizen's Platform (NCP) has announced the temporary removal of its Joint General Secretary, Salauddin Tanvir.
This decision comes as part of an internal party move, though the specific reasons for the suspension have not been detailed in the immediate reports.
Salauddin Tanvir, also known as Gazi Salauddin, is a prominent figure within the party's leadership structure.
The party has officially notified the removal, marking a significant change in its executive committee.
caption:

headline_marked: PM Tarique Rahman [[drives around Dhaka to inspect city management]]
headline: PM Tarique Rahman drives around Dhaka to inspect city management
summary: The Prime Minister personally conducted an on-site inspection of waste management, drainage, and civic services across Dhaka North City Corporation.
details: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman personally drove a vehicle to conduct an on-site inspection of civic services, waste management, and drainage across various areas of Dhaka North City Corporation.

During the tour, the Prime Minister identified several shortcomings in city management and expressed dissatisfaction with various issues, ordering immediate corrective action from relevant authorities.
The inspection spanned over two and a half hours, covering key locations including ECB Chattar, Mirpur DOHS, Uttara, Airport Road, Mohakhali, Farmgate, and Banani.
The Prime Minister was accompanied by State Minister for Local Government, Rural Development and Co-operatives Mir Shahe Alam and DNCC Administrator Md Safiqul Islam.
According to the Prime Minister's Deputy Press Secretary Jahidul Islam Rony, the Prime Minister personally inspected the ground conditions because he wants Dhaka to be a clean city.
caption:
The Prime Minister personally took the wheel to inspect Dhaka's civic services. He identified shortcomings and ordered immediate action.

Prime Minister Tarique Rahman personally drove a vehicle to conduct an on-site inspection of civic services, waste management, and drainage across various areas of Dhaka North City Corporation.

During the tour, the Prime Minister identified several shortcomings in city management and expressed dissatisfaction with various issues, ordering immediate corrective action from relevant authorities.

The inspection spanned over two and a half hours, covering key locations including ECB Chattar, Mirpur DOHS, Uttara, Airport Road, Mohakhali, Farmgate, and Banani.

The Prime Minister was accompanied by State Minister for Local Government, Rural Development and Co-operatives Mir Shahe Alam and DNCC Administrator Md Safiqul Islam.

According to the Prime Minister's Deputy Press Secretary Jahidul Islam Rony, the Prime Minister personally inspected the ground conditions because he wants Dhaka to be a clean city.
